title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The entry point that was missed
summary: Semantic tokens have two entry points. The full request learned to compare the text two releases ago; the delta request, which the editor uses most, still trusted the version number.

highlights.title: A reopened file gets its own colours
highlights.description: The delta request answered "nothing changed" on the version number alone, and the version restarts at 1 for a reopened document. Reproduced with two texts of exactly 64 characters: the second was told nothing had changed, so the editor kept the previous session colouring.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A document that really has not changed still gets the empty answer, so nothing is recomputed in normal use.
The test applies the returned edits to the previous tokens and compares the result, rather than trusting the shape of the answer.
